# RX Tracker NEXT 4.0.0-next.74

## Added

- Added per-entry notes to RX Workflow Tracking completed stages, alongside
  completion-date edits and completed-stage driver corrections.
- Workflow notes use a compact yellow sticky-note action in the RX Workflow
  Tracking modal. Saved notes display inline under the completed date and
  driver on the left side of each completed stage.
- Patient Notes now includes RX Workflow Tracking notes as read-only
  workflow-sourced entries, including the note author, timestamp, RX record,
  stage, completion date, and service date context.
- Added normalized Pharmacy Transport identity checks to manual create, edit,
  restore, and CSV import. A matching disabled record now directs the operator
  to show disabled records and restore the existing ID; a matching active
  record directs the operator to reuse the existing entry.
- Added configurable Patient Tags under Reference Data. Tags support optional
  groups, colors, notes, active/inactive status, and a default-for-new-patients
  flag.
- Added Patient Tag assignment and filtering in Patients, RX Records, and
  Reports, including multiselect dropdowns and export columns.
- Added seeded City tags for Miami and Tampa. The one-time rollout classifies
  Tampa-address patients as Tampa and defaults remaining patients to Miami,
  with case-insensitive cleanup for duplicate City tag variants.

## Database

- Adds audited migration `20260821120000-add-rx-workflow-tracking-notes` for
  optional completed-stage workflow notes.
- Includes audited migration
  `20260819120000-prevent-active-pharmacy-transport-duplicates`, adding a
  partial case/whitespace-normalized unique index that prevents multiple active
  Pharmacy Transport IDs for the same name while preserving disabled legacy
  rows and historical RX references.
- Adds audited migrations `20260904120000-create-patient-tags`,
  `20260904130000-seed-city-patient-tags`, and
  `20260904131500-normalize-city-patient-tags`.

## Safety and audit

- Workflow note changes are permission checked, stored on the completed
  workflow tracking row, recorded in RX history, and exposed in Patient Notes
  as read-only workflow entries rather than native patient-note rows.
- The RX Records page now redirects to the current build token to avoid stale
  workflow-modal JavaScript after a deployment.
- Patient Tags use soft-delete semantics so historical patient assignments are
  preserved. No CORS, FortiGate, proxy bootstrap, VPN, cookie, port, or
  `rxUrl()` behavior is changed.

## Validation

- Development operator testing confirmed workflow note creation, display, and
  Patient Notes listing behavior.
- Syntax checks passed for changed controllers, public JavaScript, migration
  files, and the RX Records EJS template. Staging/development user testing
  confirmed Patient Tags behavior, report filters, RX filters, and layout
  polish. The staging database is verified at 46 applied migrations with no
  pending migrations.
